changes.value: Display left header: pin 1 = Pico position 1. Keep pos 4 (module SRAM_CS, PSRAM CE w/ 10k pull-up), pos 7 (module SDIO_CLK via H6 jumper) and pos 19 (module GPIO14 -> R14 NC -> 3V3 LDO EN) unconnected: carrier uses GP2/GP5/GP14 for mux address/timing. LCD_BL (pos 17) has module 10k pull-up to VSYS. G01 OPEN pending physical strap check.

changes.value: Display right header: pin 1 = Pico position 40. Pin 2 (pos 39 VSYS) is the module's only 5 V entry (no diode; feeds RT9193-33 3V3 LDO and backlight regulator). Pos 40 VBUS, 36 Pico3V3 (R15 NC), 37 3V3_EN (R12 NC), 35 ADC_VREF unused by module; keep isolated so no strap variant can cause regulator contention. G01 OPEN pending physical strap check.
changes.reason: Schematic confirms VSYS entry and that isolating 35/36/37/40 is contention-free for every strap variant.
changes.citation: Waveshare schematic p1: Power block U7 RT9193-33, R11 0R / R12 NC / R14 NC / R13 100K / R15 NC (4D); U5 pos 35-40 (3B)

changes.reason: Module R16 10k pulls LCD_BL to VSYS (+5V_FUSED on carrier). Against R88 100k to GND, the node sits near 4.5 V while GP13 is high-impedance: the backlight defaults ON (the pull-down does not give an off default) and the voltage exceeds the RP2040 VPIN abs max of IOVDD+0.5 V (small clamp current, estimated below 0.1 mA, unmeasured). This is the vendor's stacked behaviour too. Decide at G01/G06 whether to keep R88, remove it, or accept and document; no value is proposed here.
